summary: Southwestern Public Service Co. (SPS), a wholly owned subsidiary of Xcel Energy Inc., filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to update the status of a November 2025 electric rate case with the New Mexico Public Regulation Commission. The filing describes intervenor testimony filed on May 1, 2026, and summarizes proposed revenue adjustments from staff and other parties. The request seeks a $168M revenue increase based on a 10.5% ROE and 56% equity ratio; intervenors recommend lower figures. The procedural schedule includes rebuttal testimony May 29, hearing July 7, and a decision expected in Q4 2026. This is a routine regulatory update, not a special situation.
